final: WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), shares AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, 1.0 * race_count / SUM(race_count) OVER () AS race_share, COUNT(*) OVER () AS circuit_count FROM circuit_counts) SELECT c.circuitId, c.name, s.race_count, s.race_share, s.race_share - 1.0 / s.circuit_count AS margin_above_average FROM shares s JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = s.circuitId ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC LIMIT 10
